_comment: Frozen NutriTURN protocol. These values define every reported number; changing one changes the paper. They are duplicated here for inspection, but the executable definitions live in audit_pipeline/lib/nfx_common.py and audit_pipeline/lib/nutrimature.py, which remain authoritative.

randomness.bootstrap: claim-clustered percentile; resampling unit is the claim, not the unit
randomness._note: MC is the Monte Carlo draw count per unit for the count-aware composition reference.

endpoint_contract.pooled_direction: p_t = (h - l) / n over signed pre-cutoff annotations when n >= SPARSE_GATE, else 0
endpoint_contract.post_cutoff: ungated: p_post uses every signed post-cutoff annotation
endpoint_contract.window: pre = records with year < t; post = records with year >= t (the cutoff year is post-cutoff)

cutoff_grid.points: 7 equally spaced points from lo + 2 to hi, deduplicated to distinct integers

agreement_definitions.A: a = 0 if n < SPARSE_GATE, else null_share when null_share >= 0.50, else (1 + |p|) / 2
agreement_definitions._note: A is the definition used for the reported two-variable system; C is the branch-free intervention reported in the agreement-definition audit.

evaluation.split: leave-one-claim-out; every cutoff of the held-out claim is excluded from fitting
evaluation.threshold: hard-decision threshold chosen on training claims only

full_representation.inventory: paper Table: Inventory of the 55 pre-cutoff variables

model._note: C was not tuned; a same-claim sweep was declined as optimistic.
